scope: Fresh independent source, guard, and private fixture review of the T57 organization checkpoint. No native run, build, release, deployment, product edit, storage injection, or request-header injection.
private_identity_check: Using the existing mode-0600 fixture and admin@admin.com credentials privately, I independently signed in against the frozen artifact's configured Supabase origin, called authenticated public.mbr_for_user for organization membership, and read iam.organizations for the fixture UUID. Exactly one current active membership and one unarchived organization matched the fixture UUID and exact approved name. No UUID, name, row, or token was printed or committed.
route_review: The hosted showcase-d47-public-admin route stages the same private organization fixture passed to showcase-picker-admin. Picker preflight requires its UUID; the native driver reads that UUID from the private file after real admin sign-in. The checkpoint requires rendered admin email, role, profile, and approved organization name. If a device choice exists it must match the approved UUID and name; absent device-choice storage is allowed for the documented load ladder.
product_request_review: The driver opens Tools and the server-owned records row, which calls the ordinary apiGet('/tools/test/list') path. CDP observes only GET /tools/test/list on the expected production API origin. It binds exactly one request ID to an HTTP 200 response and loadingFinished, compares X-Organization-Id to the independently verified private UUID, and compares the request Bearer token hash to the current panel token hash. It does not create a header or write extension storage. The observer installs listeners before the UI action, has a bounded wait, and removes listeners in finally.
independent_guard_results: All 27 focused tests passed on the exact candidate. A separate direct observer probe accepted one valid request and ignored unrelated traffic; it rejected wrong organization ID, missing Authorization, non-200 response, incomplete response, and duplicate matching requests, and confirmed listener cleanup in every case. Candidate tests additionally reject absent fixture UUID, absent or wrong X-Organization-Id, wrong Bearer token, wrong stored UUID, failed product response, and unverified admin role.
remaining_gate: Run the exact frozen native artifact through showcase-d47-public-admin then showcase-picker-admin with the private updated hosted fixture. A source test or mocked CDP event is not evidence of the actual product request. The candidate's full compile failure is in unrelated existing @ai-matrx package API imports and no TypeScript source was changed here.
